needed.suggestion: Create a proper sidewalk on the left side to improve pedestrian safety.
Remove obstructions from the right-side footway to ensure it is fully usable.
Repair any uneven sections on the right-side footway to prevent trip hazards.
Install a pedestrian crossing to provide a safe crossing point at this location.
Improve visibility of the crossing area if necessary.
